subject: Re: M-RL kickoff — resourcing and the TF1 question
body:
Ulla,

Resourcing:

Staffing — Quentin leads the sweeps, Yara owns eval/reference curves, Rosa the infra wrapping, Farah the config pinning. Comfortable with that against your milestones.

Compute — the Atari-57 sweeps (3 seeds x 57 games x 3 agent types) don't fit our standing titan-a100 share. On budget: Idris verbally earmarked $120k from Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-44 for this project, which covers the full sweep plan with headroom for re-runs. I'll treat that as committed for planning; getting it papered before Q3 OKRs lock is on my list.

On TF1: recommendation is contain, not port. We pin the environment, run it as-is (no eager mode means our standard profiling hooks don't attach, we accept that), and revisit a port only if the suite becomes load-bearing beyond this half.

Ivo
